# <span id="aanchor300"></span> Standard Reports

This function requires **Report Scheduler** privileges.

FLOWCAL provides several built-in reports created using Crystal Reports 2016. The Standard Reports screen allows you to view, print, and export data for various reports. These reports are grouped by category (e.g., Meter/Location, Source, Editor, TESTit, BLM) and display with an icon to indicate whether the report is for a gas or liquid meter, or both.

If TESTit 3 Integrated is enabled, the TESTit category and reports will not display in the Standard Reports screen; they will only be available from the TESTit application. The TESTit report category only applies to TESTit 2 Integrated.

<div class="procedure">

To access the Standard Reports screen:

Go to **Reports** \> **Standard Reports**.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 611;height: 501;" />

</div>

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Run a Report</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Run a Report">

<div class="procedure">

To run a report from the Standard Reports screen:

1.  Expand a category heading in the Report Selection menu.

2.  Click a report name to select a single report, or click the checkboxes next to multiple report names to select more than one report.

3.  Use the available options on the right side of the screen to select the report data you want to display. These configuration options will vary for each report. The more reports you select, the more fields will be available.

4.  Click **Preview**, **Print**, **Export** or **Email** to configure the report output.

    The **Email** button will only be enabled if you have licensed the Scheduled Reporting module.

<div class="example">

Tip - Remember UI Filter Values

If the **Remember UI Filter Values** option is enabled (see: [User Preferences](../Settings%20Manager/User%20Settings/User%20Preferences.md)), the Standard Reports screen will retain the following filter and date settings for the duration of the FLOWCAL session:

- Object type (Meter, Location, List, or Close Group); object number or name (e.g., meter number) will not be retained
- Date range type and selection
- Report list selection, level, resolution, volume/energy, revision, and number of decimals

When multiple Standard Reports screens are open, the filter and date settings from the last Standard Reports screen closed will be retained. The filter settings are cleared when you log out or close FLOWCAL.

</div>

</div>

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Function Buttons">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Function Buttons</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Function Buttons">

The following report functions are available on the Standard Reports screen:

- **Preview** - Open the Report Viewer to view the results of your report selections and export or print reports. If you have selected multiple reports, each report will display on a separate tab.
- **Print** - Select a printer and print options for the report.
- **Export** - Open the Choose an Export File Directory screen to specify a network path, file format, and other output options. (See: [Export a Report](Export%20a%20Report.md))
- **E-mail** - Open the Email Reports screen and configure email and recipient options. (See: [Email a Report](Email%20a%20Report.md))
- **Exit** - Close the Standard Reports screen.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Right-Click">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Right-Click Options</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Right-Click">

The following report functions are available in the right-click menu:

- **Description** - Quickly identify the report’s purpose, or add a description to a custom report. You can also edit the description by going to **Edit** \> **Description**.

- **Add** - Open the Available Reports screen to install custom reports found in the **Crystal\Custom** directory of the FLOWCAL installation folder.

  If you want to create a custom report, you will need to purchase a Crystal Reports Developer license. A Crystal license is not required if you are only running reports.

- **Refresh** - Update the list of categories and reports.

- **Category Access** - Open the Category Access screen to grant/restrict access to categories. (See: [Report Access](Report%20Access.md))

- **Report Access** - Open the Report Access screen to grant/restrict access to reports. (See: [Report Access](Report%20Access.md))

</div>
